trajectory_summary: This is a short, low-friction rebook call: the customer was already expecting contact and cooperative throughout, and the two negotiated a workable day/time despite some calendar back-and-forth. The rep never lost the thread, but also never added value beyond pure logistics — no bill re-anchor, no interest reinforcement, no confirmed co-attendee, and a thin button-up.
